records.title: B1. Neural specificity remains unestablished
records.exact_original_request: Validity, recursive qualification, the AVaR enclosure, the information lower bound, and the fallback are representation-neutral. The ReLU family is not the complete-work winner and is never certified adopted over quadratic least squares.
records.inherited_r125_amendment: We retain the original NBO continuation critic, feasible actor, recursive Bellman target and economic decision problem. Theorem fullinterpolation125 gives an exact finite convex representation of the information in every paid original quadratic support, including an uncertain but globally valid supporting slope. This closes the explicit raw-support omission in the R124 information class. Theorem paidwork125 links original support precision to feasible action localization, its declared work bound and a separate returned-policy gate. Both mechanisms are available to every representation under the same information. The R125 protocol retains all 56 original actors and the exactly matched ordinary-hinge control.
records.inherited_r125_remaining_requirement: Neural-specific economic or information superiority remains unestablished. The support-complete program has not been implemented in the production R125 service census. A strict analytic witness demonstrates lost information, but cheap direct support evaluation attains its improvement. Neither that witness nor a shared decision safeguard establishes an advantage over an equally informed conventional method.
records.r126_action: Await actual new author amendments and executed evidence; do not mark closed by this provenance audit.

records.title: B2. The information-complexity result is too narrow for the platform claim
records.exact_original_request: The theorem is a specialized deterministic one-dimensional oracle result. It does not establish randomized, multivariate, nonuniform-law, or end-to-end Bellman complexity lower bounds.
records.inherited_r125_amendment: Theorem fullinterpolation125 identifies the exact worst compatible action contrast for a fixed pair under a scalar, smooth strongly convex, complete-support information interface. It explicitly excludes additional economic formulas unless encoded. The support inequalities are convex bounded-domain conjugate constraints; necessity, constructive sufficiency, compactness, degenerate cases and rational residual certification are proved. The terminal bracket proposition separately gives a matching randomized-action minimax result for its reduced stationary-bracket interface.
records.inherited_r125_remaining_requirement: These exact local information results are not end-to-end Bellman complexity lower bounds. Randomized acquisition, multivariate innovations, arbitrary derivative oracles, nonuniform laws and uniform extreme-tail constants require additional adversarial classes and matching algorithms. The conditional power-law oracle premise in paidwork125 is not inferred from observed runtime.
records.r126_action: Await actual new author amendments and executed evidence; do not mark closed by this provenance audit.

records.inherited_r125_remaining_requirement: A neural-versus-conventional policy or service-work separation with equal features, information, feasible policies and full costs still requires evidence.
